title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Pod Fill x2 Melon Citrus 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Doozy’s Seriously Pod Fill x2 Melon Citrus is a refreshing fusion of juicy Melon and zesty Citrus, delivering a vibrant balance of sweet and tangy notes. The Melon introduces a smooth, succulent sweetness, while the bright Citrus adds a lively kick of tartness, creating a layered and uplifting vape that lingers on the tastebuds. With a 50% VG / 50% PG formulation and double-concentrated flavour, this e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, making it ideal for low-powered vape kits, pod systems, starter devices, and high-resistance coils. The balanced blend ensures a consistent flavour with a tactile yet smooth throat hit and discreet vapour production. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing for customisable nicotine strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Doozy is a UK-based e-liquid brand known for its dynamic flavour profiles and high-quality formulations. The Seriously Pod Fill x2 range is crafted specifically for MTL vapers, delivering rich, concentrated flavours in a 50/50 mix designed for pod systems and starter devices.
